# orchestration_cluster_group (Resource)

A group inside a Camunda cluster. Groups bundle users, clients and mapping rules within that single cluster so that roles, tenants and authorizations can be assigned to them together. See the Camunda documentation on [groups](https://docs.camunda.io/docs/components/admin/group/).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "orchestration_cluster_group" "example" {
  group_id    = "my-group"
  name        = "My Group"
  description = "A group managed by Terraform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The unique ID for the group.
- `name` (String) The display name of the group.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the group. Omit this attribute (or set it to `null`) to indicate no description — the API cannot distinguish an empty string from an absent description, so an explicitly configured empty string is rejected rather than silently normalized to null.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique ID of the group (the group ID).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import orchestration_cluster_group.example "my-group"
```
